dek: Set for 13 September 2026 at The Caribbean Grande, Pakuwon City, this orthopedic-themed half marathon runs in Surabaya, Indonesia's second-largest city and East Java's provincial capital.
verdict: The Surabaya Orthopedic Half Marathon carries a distinctive medical branding -- its name signals a health/orthopedic-industry tie-in that's uncommon among the races in this research batch, though the specific organiser or hospital sponsor behind that theme isn't detailed in available material. Three distances (5K, 10K, 21.1K) at the Pakuwon City development in Surabaya give it broad accessibility, and pricing is genuinely affordable (roughly Rp 137,500-450,000). Surabaya itself is Indonesia's second-largest city, a historic port with real urban infrastructure -- a far easier logistics base than several smaller-city races in this batch.

sections.heading: Surabaya: Indonesia's Second City
paragraphs: Surabaya is Indonesia's second-largest city and the capital of East Java province, sitting on the northern shore of Java at the mouth of the Mas River. [2] It's one of the country's busiest ports, with a population of around three million in the city proper and at least five million across the metro area -- genuinely major-city infrastructure that makes travel, accommodation and logistics considerably easier than in some of the smaller destinations in this batch.
